statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-31900 affects black's GitHub action configuration parsing (fixed in black 26.3.0). As with CVE-2024-21503 and CVE-2026-32274 in this file, black 22.3.0 is an SBOM false positive: acryl-datahub declares it in a dev-only extra, but the package is NOT installed in any variant. Verified on the built dhi/datahub-actions:1.5.0.7-debian13 and 1.5.0.7-debian13-dev images: no black distribution exists under /opt/datahub/lib/python3.10/site-packages and no /opt/datahub/bin/black entry point exists. The vulnerable GitHub action code cannot execute because black itself is not present.

CVE-2026-31900 affects black's GitHub action configuration parsing (fixed in black 26.3.0). As with CVE-2024-21503 and CVE-2026-32274 in this file, black 22.3.0 is an SBOM false positive: acryl-datahub declares it in a dev-only extra, but the package is NOT installed in any variant. Verified on the built dhi/datahub-actions:1.5.0.7-debian13 and 1.5.0.7-debian13-dev images: no black distribution exists under /opt/datahub/lib/python3.10/site-packages and no /opt/datahub/bin/black entry point exists. The vulnerable GitHub action code cannot execute because black itself is not present.

CVE-2024-21503 is a ReDoS in black's lines.py (fixed in black 24.3.0), triggerable only when black formats crafted source code. As with CVE-2026-32274 in this file, black 22.3.0 is an SBOM false positive: acryl-datahub declares it in a dev-only extra, but the package is NOT installed in any variant. Verified on the built dhi/datahub-actions:1.5.0.7-debian13 and 1.5.0.7-debian13-full images: no black distribution exists under /opt/datahub/lib/python3.10/site-packages and no /opt/datahub/bin/black entry point exists. The vulnerable formatter cannot execute because black itself is not present.

SBOM false-positive: black 22.3.0 is listed in /opt/docker/sbom/datahub-actions/.spdx.datahub-actions.json because acryl-datahub declares it in a dev-only extra, but the package is NOT installed in any variant. Verified: `pip show black` returns 'Package(s) not found' on the dhi/datahub-actions:1-dev image; `find /opt -name 'black*'` returns only /opt/datahub/lib/python3.10/site-packages/datahub/ingestion/sink/blackhole.py (datahub's no-op metadata sink, unrelated to the black formatter). The vulnerable code path (black formatting a maliciously-named source file with path traversal) cannot execute because black itself is not present.
